content: The F1 score achieved after re-annotating the 600 most-difficult articles reaches 68.1%, which is close to the performance when re-annotating 1000 random articles. This demonstrates the effectiveness of recognizing difficult instances. The trend when we use up all expert data is still upward, so adding even more expert data is likely to further improve performance. Unfortunately we exhausted our budget and were not able to obtain additional expert annotations. It is likely that as the size of the expert annotations increases, the value of crowd annotations will diminish. This investigation is left for future work.
